generic.Defined scope/population: Every recipient on the current reinsurance MI matrix across Underwriting, Finance, ERM, and reinsurance leadership
generic.In-scope period: The closed reporting month, circulated on or before working day 8
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Covering note states pack version, reporting period, and the locked PDF or BI link
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Delivery confirmations counted equal the recipient count on the matrix
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sent covering note and locked pack filed to the monthly MI folder with send timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Bounced or unconfirmed deliveries logged with the resend action and final outcome
generic.Test population: All delivery records for the reporting month checked against the recipient matrix
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any matrix recipient lacks a delivery confirmation or the send is after working day 8
generic.Exception handling path: Analyst resends failed deliveries and escalates unresolved recipients to the Reinsurance Ops Manager
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Locked pack matching the signed-off version reached every recipient by working day 8
generic.Evidence location: Monthly MI folder for the period plus the BI/reporting platform subscription delivery log

steps.title: Identify the signed-off MI pack version in the BI/reporting platform
sop: Open the monthly reinsurance MI report in the BI/reporting platform.
Check the version reference and reporting period against the sign-off record on the cover sheet.
Export or lock the approved version as the distribution PDF or shareable link.
Done when the locked pack version for the period is identified and exported.
verify: Compare the exported pack version reference against the signed-off report record.
Pass when the locked pack matches the signed-off version and reporting period.

steps.title: Refresh the distribution list against the current recipient matrix
sop: Open the standing reinsurance MI distribution list in Microsoft Teams / Email.
Compare it line by line to the current recipient matrix for Underwriting, Finance, ERM, and leadership.
Add joiners, remove leavers, and correct any changed group mailbox.
Done when the distribution list matches the current recipient matrix.
verify: Count list entries against matrix entries and inspect the differences.
Pass when no matrix recipient is missing and no non-matrix recipient remains.

steps.title: Draft the covering note in Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Create the covering note naming the reporting period and pack version reference.
Summarise the headline ceded and assumed movements for the month in the body.
Attach the locked PDF or embed the BI/reporting platform link.
Done when the covering note is drafted with period, version, and pack reference present.
verify: Read the drafted note against the locked pack cover sheet.
Pass when period and version in the note match the pack exactly.

steps.title: Send the locked MI pack to the standing distribution list
sop: Send the covering note and locked pack from Microsoft Teams / Email by working day 8.
Enable read receipts or trigger the BI/reporting platform subscription for the period.
Record the send date and time against the period entry in the MI tracker.
Done when the pack has been sent to the full distribution list.
verify: Check the recorded send timestamp against the working day 8 deadline.
Pass when the send timestamp is on or before working day 8.

steps.title: Capture delivery confirmations from receipts and the BI subscription log
sop: Collect read receipts from Microsoft Teams / Email for each recipient.
Export the BI/reporting platform subscription delivery log for the period.
Enter a delivery confirmation against each recipient in the MI tracker.
Done when a confirmation status is recorded for every recipient.
verify: Reconcile confirmed recipients to the recipient matrix count.
Pass when a delivery entry exists for every recipient for the period.

steps.title: Resend to recipients with no confirmed delivery
sop: List recipients with a bounce, block, or no confirmation after two working days.
Correct the address or access permission and resend the locked pack.
Log each failure with the cause and the resend outcome in the MI tracker.
Done when every unconfirmed recipient has been resent or escalated.
verify: Review the failure log for open items without a disposition.
Pass when no delivery failure remains without a resend outcome or escalation.

steps.title: File the circulated pack and covering note to the monthly MI folder
sop: Save the exact circulated pack and covering note to the monthly MI folder for the period.
Name the files with the reporting period and pack version reference.
Attach the delivery confirmation export to the same folder.
Done when pack, note, and delivery evidence are filed for the period.
verify: Open the period folder and check for pack, covering note, and delivery log.
Pass when all three items are present and version stamped.

steps.title: Confirm circulation completeness with the Reinsurance Ops Manager
sop: Review the MI tracker entry for the period covering send date and confirmations.
Challenge any recipient without a delivery confirmation or any late send.
Record confirmation of circulation against the period entry.
Done when circulation for the period is confirmed by the Reinsurance Ops Manager.
verify: Check the confirmation entry names the reviewer and the date.
Pass when circulation is confirmed with no open delivery exception.

generic.Defined scope/population: All ceded and assumed programs with premium, commission, or loss activity in the reporting month
generic.In-scope period: The closed reporting month, extracted after the period close date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Premium, commission, paid loss, and outstanding loss populated for every program in the pack
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ceded premium and recoverable balances agree to the general ledger reinsurance control accounts
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: MI workbook saved with extract timestamp, preparer and reviewer initials, and version reference
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unreconciled differences and threshold variances logged with cause commentary and disposition
generic.Test population: All programs in the monthly MI pack plus the matching control account balances
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any GL difference is unexplained or the extract predates the period close date
generic.Exception handling path: Analyst investigates with the Reinsurance Accountant and escalates unresolved breaks to the Ops Manager
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete drafted MI pack tied to the ledger with commentary on every threshold variance
generic.Evidence location: Monthly MI folder for the period holding the workbook, extracts, and reconciliation

steps.title: Extract ceded and assumed activity from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Run the monthly ceded and assumed extract in the reinsurance administration system after period close.
Include premium, commission, paid loss, and outstanding loss by program and treaty.
Record the extract run timestamp and the as-at date on the extract sheet.
Done when the monthly extract is produced with its run timestamp recorded.
verify: Compare the extract run timestamp against the period close date.
Pass when the extract timestamp is after the period close date.

steps.title: Load the extract into the MI workbook in Microsoft Excel
sop: Paste the extract into the data tab of the monthly MI workbook in Microsoft Excel.
Refresh all workbook links and pivot sources against the new data tab.
Scan for #REF! errors, stale period labels, and hard-coded overrides and clear them.
Done when the workbook is refreshed and free of broken or overridden values.
verify: Run the workbook error check and inspect the period labels on each sheet.
Pass when no #REF!, stale period, or hard-coded override remains.

steps.title: Tie ceded balances to the general ledger control accounts
sop: Pull the reinsurance control account balances for the period from the ledger.
Compare ceded premium and recoverable balances in the workbook to those control accounts.
Itemise each difference with its cause and clear or explain it.
Done when every difference is cleared or carries a written explanation.
verify: Review the reconciliation sheet for unexplained residual differences.
Pass when no unexplained difference remains between MI and the control accounts.

steps.title: Build the program performance views in the BI/reporting platform
sop: Refresh the monthly reinsurance MI dataset in the BI/reporting platform.
Render ceded and assumed performance by program with month-on-month comparatives.
Confirm the BI figures agree to the reconciled workbook totals.
Done when the BI views render the reconciled figures for the period.
verify: Spot-check three program totals in BI against the workbook.
Pass when BI and workbook totals agree for every checked program.

steps.title: Write variance commentary for programs beyond the reporting threshold
sop: List every program with a month-on-month movement beyond the reporting threshold.
Investigate each movement back to the underlying cessions or loss transactions.
Write a cause commentary naming rate, loss activity, timing, or data as the driver.
Done when every threshold-breaching program has a written commentary.
verify: Filter the variance sheet for breaches without commentary text.
Pass when no threshold breach is left without a cause commentary.

steps.title: Review the drafted pack with the Reinsurance Accountant
sop: Review the drafted MI pack against the reconciliation and the ledger balances.
Challenge commentary that does not explain the movement shown.
Record review points and confirm they are cleared in the workbook.
Done when accountant review points are cleared on the drafted pack.
verify: Check the review log for open points on the drafted pack.
Pass when no review point remains open.

steps.title: Record preparer and reviewer initials on the MI cover sheet
sop: Enter preparer initials and preparation date on the MI cover sheet.
Obtain reviewer initials and review date from the Reinsurance Ops Manager.
Stamp the pack version reference and reporting period on the cover sheet.
Done when preparer and reviewer initials plus dates are present on the cover sheet.
verify: Inspect the cover sheet for initials, dates, version, and period.
Pass when all four fields are populated before release.

steps.title: File the completed workbook and extracts to the monthly MI folder
sop: Save the completed MI workbook to the monthly MI folder with its version reference.
Attach the source extract and the ledger reconciliation to the same folder.
Lock the workbook version so later edits create a new version.
Done when workbook, extract, and reconciliation are filed for the period.
verify: Open the period folder and confirm the three artefacts exist.
Pass when workbook, extract, and reconciliation are all present and versioned.

generic.Defined scope/population: Underwriting, Finance, and ERM stakeholder groups on the MI distribution tracker
generic.In-scope period: The current MI reporting period being published to the shared reporting workspace
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Notification carries the direct MI link, reporting period, and headline movements
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Acknowledged groups on the tracker equal the groups holding current-period access
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Publication record and notification retained with publish timestamp and pack version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Groups without acknowledgement after two working days logged with the chase and outcome
generic.Test population: All stakeholder groups listed on the distribution tracker for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any recipient group lacks current-period access or a recorded acknowledgement
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Analyst chases non-acknowledging groups and refers persistent gaps to the Ops Manager
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: MI published with access granted and every group acknowledgement recorded for the period
generic.Evidence location: Shared reporting workspace publication log and the period distribution tracker

steps.title: Publish the MI pack to the shared reporting workspace
sop: Upload the approved MI pack to the shared reporting workspace on the BI/reporting platform.
Stamp the item with the reporting period and pack version reference.
Retire or supersede the prior period item so only the current pack is prominent.
Done when the current pack is published with period and version stamped.
verify: Open the workspace item and read the period and version metadata.
Pass when the published item shows the correct period and version.

steps.title: Grant workspace access to Underwriting, Finance, and ERM groups
sop: Open the workspace permission settings on the BI/reporting platform.
Grant read access to the Underwriting, Finance, and ERM recipient groups.
Remove access for groups no longer on the recipient matrix.
Done when the three recipient groups hold current-period access.
verify: Export the workspace access list and compare it to the recipient matrix.
Pass when all three recipient groups appear with current-period access.

steps.title: Draft the stakeholder notification in Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Write the notification with the direct link to the published pack.
State the reporting period and summarise the key headline movements in the body.
Name the acknowledgement expectation and the two working day response window.
Done when the notification is drafted with link, period, and headlines present.
verify: Click the embedded link from a stakeholder view and read the body text.
Pass when the link resolves to the current pack and period and headlines are stated.

steps.title: Send the notification to the stakeholder groups
sop: Send the notification to the Underwriting, Finance, and ERM groups.
Record the send timestamp against the period entry on the distribution tracker.
Open a tracker row for each group awaiting acknowledgement.
Done when the notification is sent and tracker rows are open for each group.
verify: Check the tracker for a row per recipient group with a send timestamp.
Pass when every group has a row with a recorded send timestamp.

steps.title: Log stakeholder acknowledgements on the distribution tracker
sop: Collect acknowledgement replies from Microsoft Teams / Email for each group.
Record the acknowledging person, group, and date on the distribution tracker.
Leave rows open where no acknowledgement has been received.
Done when every received acknowledgement is logged against its group.
verify: Filter the tracker for rows without an acknowledgement entry.
Pass when logged acknowledgements match the replies received.

steps.title: Chase groups without acknowledgement after two working days
sop: Identify tracker rows still open after two working days from the send date.
Send a chase to the group contact naming the pack and the period.
Record the chase date and the response on the tracker row.
Done when every open row has a recorded chase or an acknowledgement.
verify: Review open tracker rows for a recorded chase date.
Pass when no open row is older than two working days without a chase.

steps.title: Close the distribution tracker for the period
sop: Review the tracker for the period against the recipient matrix.
Escalate any group still unacknowledged after the chase cycle.
Mark the period distribution as complete once all groups are acknowledged or escalated.
Done when the period distribution entry is closed by the Reinsurance Ops Manager.
verify: Check the closure entry names the reviewer and the closure date.
Pass when no recipient group is left without an acknowledgement or escalation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Quarterly reinsurance performance across ceded spend, recoveries, net loss position, and retention performance
generic.In-scope period: The reporting quarter presented at the scheduled CUO, CFO, and CEO session
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pack shows ceded spend, recoveries, net loss, net PML movement, and reinsurance cost to gross written premium
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pack figures agree to the published quarterly reinsurance reporting dataset
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Pack version and upload timestamp held on the board portal with the annotated post-session copy
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Executive questions unresolved in session logged as follow-up actions with owners and due dates
generic.Test population: The uploaded quarterly pack and the full action log arising from the session
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the pack posted later than five days before the meeting or any action lacks owner or due date
generic.Exception handling path: Head of Reinsurance assigns unresolved questions to the Reinsurance Manager with a due date
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Pack presented to CUO, CFO, and CEO with annotated pack and action log circulated within two working days
generic.Evidence location: Executive board portal quarter folder holding the pack, annotated copy, and action log

steps.title: Assemble the quarterly performance content in the BI/reporting platform
sop: Refresh the quarterly reinsurance dataset in the BI/reporting platform.
Pull ceded spend, recoveries, net loss position, and retention performance versus plan.
Add quarter-on-quarter net PML movement and reinsurance cost as a share of gross written premium.
Done when all required quarterly measures are assembled for the pack.
verify: Compare each assembled measure against the published quarterly reporting dataset.
Pass when every measure agrees to the published dataset for the quarter.

steps.title: Review and finalise the executive pack narrative
sop: Read the drafted pack for consistency between the figures and the narrative.
Sharpen the messages on retention performance and reinsurance cost efficiency.
Mark the pack as the final executive version with a version reference.
Done when the pack is finalised with a version reference for the quarter.
verify: Check the pack version reference and that narrative claims trace to a chart or table.
Pass when every narrative claim is supported by a figure inside the pack.

steps.title: Upload the pack to the board portal ahead of the session
sop: Upload the final pack to the quarter folder on the board portal.
Set access for the CUO, CFO, and CEO and confirm the meeting date on the item.
Complete the upload at least five days before the session.
Done when the pack is posted to the board portal for the session.
verify: Compare the portal upload timestamp against the scheduled meeting date.
Pass when the pack was posted at least five days before the meeting.

steps.title: Present ceded spend, recoveries, and net loss position to the executives
sop: Walk the executives through ceded spend and recoveries for the quarter.
Present the net loss position and retention performance against plan.
Answer challenge on any variance from the planned retention outcome.
Done when the performance section has been presented and challenged.
verify: Check the meeting record covers ceded spend, recoveries, net loss, and retention.
Pass when all four sections are recorded as presented.

steps.title: Present the net PML and reinsurance cost movement
sop: Show quarter-on-quarter movement in net PML by peak zone.
Show reinsurance cost as a percentage of gross written premium and the trend.
Explain the drivers behind any material movement in either measure.
Done when the PML and cost movement section has been presented.
verify: Check the presented movement figures against the BI/reporting platform source.
Pass when presented movements agree to the source dataset.

steps.title: Capture executive questions, decisions, and follow-up actions
sop: Record each executive question and the answer given in the session.
Record every decision taken and every follow-up action arising.
Assign a named owner and a due date to each action.
Done when all questions, decisions, and actions are captured with owners and dates.
verify: Filter the action log for entries without an owner or a due date.
Pass when every action has a named owner and a due date.

steps.title: Circulate the annotated pack and action log within two working days
sop: Annotate the pack with the decisions and answers given in the session.
Attach the action log and circulate both to the executive attendees.
File the annotated pack and action log in the board portal quarter folder.
Done when the annotated pack and action log are circulated and filed.
verify: Compare the circulation timestamp against the session date.
Pass when circulation occurred within two working days of the session.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force assumed treaties in the analysis period by treaty and underwriting year
generic.In-scope period: The analysis period covering current underwriting year and prior-year development separately
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assumed premium, incurred loss, acquisition cost, brokerage, and combined ratio present per treaty
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total assumed premium in the analysis agrees to the assumed ledger balance for the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Analysis workbook saved with extract date, version reference, and review record
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Treaties above the combined ratio target logged with a cause commentary and review outcome
generic.Test population: Every in-force assumed treaty extracted for the analysis period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any treaty above the combined ratio target lacks a written cause commentary
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Analyst refers unexplained treaty results to the Reinsurance Actuary before review
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Ranked treaty profitability reviewed with the Reinsurance Manager before renewal use
generic.Evidence location: Treaty profitability folder holding the workbook, extract, and ledger reconciliation

steps.title: Extract assumed treaty results from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Run the assumed treaty result extract for the analysis period by treaty and underwriting year.
Include premium, incurred loss, acquisition cost, and brokerage on every treaty row.
Confirm the extract covers all in-force assumed treaties for the period.
Done when the assumed treaty extract is produced for the analysis period.
verify: Compare the extracted treaty list against the assumed in-force register.
Pass when every in-force assumed treaty appears in the extract.

steps.title: Build the treaty combined ratio view in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load the extract into the treaty profitability workbook in Microsoft Excel.
Calculate loss ratio, expense ratio, and combined ratio per treaty and underwriting year.
Check that no treaty row carries a null premium or a null loss component.
Done when combined ratio is calculated for every treaty row.
verify: Filter the workbook for rows with missing ratio components.
Pass when every treaty row has a complete calculated combined ratio.

steps.title: Split current underwriting year from prior-year development
sop: Separate current underwriting year result from prior-year reserve development in the workbook.
Show both components alongside the all-years total for each treaty.
Confirm reserve movement is not folded into current-year performance.
Done when current-year and prior-year development are reported separately.
verify: Recompute the all-years total from the two components for a sample of treaties.
Pass when the components sum to the all-years total on every sampled treaty.

steps.title: Reconcile total assumed premium to the assumed ledger balance
sop: Pull the assumed premium ledger balance for the analysis period.
Compare it to the total assumed premium in the profitability analysis.
Investigate and explain any difference before the analysis is used.
Done when the analysis premium total is reconciled to the ledger.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation sheet for residual unexplained differences.
Pass when no unexplained difference remains against the assumed ledger.

steps.title: Flag treaties above the portfolio combined ratio target
sop: Apply the portfolio combined ratio target to every treaty row.
Flag each treaty breaching the target and rank them by premium exposed.
Write a cause commentary naming rate, loss activity, or commission for each flagged treaty.
Done when every flagged treaty carries a written cause commentary.
verify: Filter flagged treaties for rows without commentary text.
Pass when no flagged treaty is left without a cause commentary.

steps.title: Review the actuarial view on prior-year development
sop: Review the prior-year development shown per treaty class against the reserving view.
Challenge treaties where the development shown conflicts with the reserving position.
Confirm or correct the development split used in the analysis.
Done when the actuarial view on development is confirmed in the workbook.
verify: Compare treaty development in the analysis to the latest reserving output.
Pass when the analysis development agrees to the reserving view or the difference is explained.

steps.title: Publish the treaty profitability view to the BI/reporting platform
sop: Publish the reconciled treaty profitability dataset to the BI/reporting platform.
Stamp the published view with the analysis period, extract date, and version.
Confirm the published totals agree to the workbook.
Done when the treaty profitability view is published and stamped.
verify: Compare three published treaty results against the workbook rows.
Pass when published and workbook results agree for every checked treaty.

steps.title: Review the ranked treaty list with the Reinsurance Manager
sop: Walk the ranked treaty list and the flagged underperformers with the analyst.
Challenge the cause commentary where it does not explain the result.
Confirm the list is fit to inform renewal decisions and record the review.
Done when the ranked list is reviewed and recorded by the Reinsurance Manager.
verify: Check the review record names the reviewer, the version reviewed, and the date.
Pass when the review is recorded before the analysis is used for renewal decisions.

generic.Defined scope/population: All retro layers placed or planned plus peak peril zones carrying modelled net PML
generic.In-scope period: The year-to-date position as at the briefing date, including events already incurred
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Retro spend versus budget, unplaced layers, gross and net PML, and remaining limit populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Retro spend to date agrees to the reinsurance ledger retro premium balance
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Briefing pack filed with as-at date, model version, and briefing date in the governance file
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Layers eroded below the agreed remaining limit threshold logged with the mitigating action
generic.Test population: All retro layers and every peak peril zone in the briefing pack
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if net-of-retro PML is missing at any agreed return period for a peak zone
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Manager escalates unplaced or exhausted layers to the Head of Reinsurance for decision
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Senior management briefed and acknowledgement recorded in the reinsurance governance file
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance governance file entry for the briefing with the pack and acknowledgement

steps.title: Compile retro spend against budget in Microsoft Excel
sop: Pull retro premium booked to date and the approved retro budget into the briefing workbook.
Show spend against budget by layer and the remaining budget available.
List layers still unplaced or unpriced at the briefing date.
Done when spend against budget and unplaced layers are compiled.
verify: Reconcile retro spend to date to the reinsurance ledger retro premium balance.
Pass when spend agrees to the ledger with no unexplained difference.

steps.title: Pull gross and net-of-retro PML from the BI/reporting platform
sop: Open the catastrophe exposure view on the BI/reporting platform.
Extract gross and net-of-retro PML at the agreed return periods for each peak zone.
Record the model version, event set, and as-at date alongside the figures.
Done when gross and net PML are extracted for every peak zone.
verify: Check each peak zone has a value at every agreed return period.
Pass when no peak zone or return period is missing a net-of-retro figure.

steps.title: Assess layer erosion from year-to-date events
sop: List the year-to-date events that have attached to any retro layer.
Calculate limit consumed and remaining limit for each affected layer.
Highlight layers where remaining limit sits below the agreed threshold.
Done when remaining limit is stated for every layer touched by events.
verify: Filter the layer schedule for touched layers without a remaining limit figure.
Pass when remaining limit is stated for every layer touched year to date.

steps.title: Quantify reinstatement premium exposure at the current loss position
sop: Apply reinstatement terms to the current loss position for each affected layer.
Calculate the reinstatement premium payable and any further exposure if losses develop.
Show the total reinstatement exposure against the retro budget headroom.
Done when reinstatement premium exposure is quantified for the briefing.
verify: Recalculate reinstatement premium for one layer against the treaty terms.
Pass when the recalculated figure agrees to the briefing pack.

steps.title: Assemble the retrocession briefing pack
sop: Build the pack from spend versus budget, PML positions, erosion, and reinstatement exposure.
State the model version, event set, and as-at date on the front page.
Name the decisions being sought from senior management.
Done when the briefing pack is assembled with an as-at date and decisions stated.
verify: Read the pack front page for model version, event set, and as-at date.
Pass when all three are stated on the assembled pack.

steps.title: Deliver the retrocession briefing to senior management
sop: Present retro spend, net PML, erosion, and reinstatement exposure to senior management.
Take challenge on unplaced layers and layers close to exhaustion.
Record decisions taken and any further action required.
Done when the briefing is delivered and decisions are recorded.
verify: Check the briefing record lists attendees, decisions, and any actions.
Pass when the record is complete for the briefing session.

steps.title: Record the briefing and acknowledgement in the governance file
sop: File the briefing pack in the reinsurance governance file for the period.
Record the briefing date, attendees, and the senior management acknowledgement.
Log any action arising with an owner and a due date.
Done when the briefing, attendees, and acknowledgement are recorded.
verify: Open the governance file entry and check date, attendees, and acknowledgement.
Pass when the acknowledgement is recorded against the delivered pack.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every assumed treaty renewed, declined, restructured, or non-renewed in the reporting period
generic.In-scope period: The renewal reporting period covered by the portfolio actions report
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Signed line, share, risk-adjusted rate change, and commission movement populated per treaty
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Treaty count in the report agrees to the renewal register in the administration system
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued report filed in the treaty governance folder with period and version reference
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Treaties written outside standard terms logged with the authority approval reference
generic.Test population: All assumed treaties with a renewal decision recorded in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any renewed treaty lacks a signed line and share or an off-standard treaty lacks an approval
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Analyst refers missing approvals to the Reinsurance Manager before the report is issued
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Report issued to the governance committee distribution and filed for the period
generic.Evidence location: Treaty governance folder holding the issued report and the source renewal extract

steps.title: Extract the renewal decision register from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Run the assumed renewal decision extract for the reporting period.
Include treaties renewed, declined, restructured, and non-renewed with the decision date.
Confirm the extract row count against the renewal register.
Done when the renewal decision extract is produced for the period.
verify: Compare extract row count to the renewal register count for the period.
Pass when the counts agree with no missing decision.

steps.title: Populate signed line and share for each renewed treaty
sop: Pull the signed line and share for each renewed treaty from the administration system.
Populate the report row for each treaty with line and share.
Chase placement for any renewed treaty with no recorded signed line.
Done when every renewed treaty carries a signed line and share.
verify: Filter renewed treaty rows for blank line or share fields.
Pass when no renewed treaty is missing a signed line and share.

steps.title: Calculate risk-adjusted rate change and commission movement
sop: Compare renewal terms against expiring terms for each treaty.
Calculate risk-adjusted rate change and the movement in ceding commission.
Note any treaty where exposure change drives the rate movement.
Done when rate change and commission movement are calculated per treaty.
verify: Recalculate rate change on a sample of treaties from expiring and renewal terms.
Pass when sampled recalculations agree to the report.

steps.title: Identify treaties written outside standard terms
sop: Compare each treaty against the standard terms and authority parameters.
Flag treaties written outside standard terms or above delegated limit.
Attach the authority approval reference that permitted each off-standard treaty.
Done when every off-standard treaty carries an approval reference.
verify: Filter off-standard treaties for rows without an approval reference.
Pass when each off-standard treaty references a recorded approval.

steps.title: Summarise the net portfolio effect of the period actions
sop: Calculate the change in assumed premium income from the period actions.
Show the change in aggregate exposure and the movement in cedent count.
Explain the portfolio shift driven by the declined and non-renewed treaties.
Done when the net portfolio effect summary is complete.
verify: Recompute premium income change from the treaty rows.
Pass when the summary figures agree to the underlying treaty rows.

steps.title: Publish the portfolio actions view to the BI/reporting platform
sop: Publish the portfolio actions dataset to the BI/reporting platform.
Stamp the published view with the reporting period and version reference.
Confirm published totals agree to the source extract.
Done when the portfolio actions view is published and stamped.
verify: Compare published treaty counts and premium totals to the extract.
Pass when published and extracted totals agree.

steps.title: Issue the report to the governance committee distribution
sop: Review the report for completeness of decisions, lines, rate change, and approvals.
Issue it to the governance committee distribution for the period.
File the issued version in the treaty governance folder.
Done when the report is issued and filed for the period.
verify: Check the governance folder for the issued version and its distribution record.
Pass when the issued report and its distribution record are both filed.

generic.Defined scope/population: All ceded programs and assumed treaty classes with activity in the reporting period
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period published, with prior period comparatives restated on the same basis
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Ceded written and earned premium, paid and outstanding recoveries, net loss, assumed premium, and combined ratio
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ceded premium and recoverables agree to the general ledger reinsurance control accounts
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published dataset stamped with reporting period, extract date, and version reference
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Restatements and unreconciled items logged with a footnote explanation and disposition
generic.Test population: The published dataset for the period plus the matching control account balances
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if period, extract date, or version is blank or any control account difference is unreconciled
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Analyst refers unreconciled balances to the Reinsurance Accountant before publication
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reconciled ceded and assumed metrics published with comparatives and version stamping
generic.Evidence location: Enterprise data warehouse published dataset plus the period reconciliation file

steps.title: Extract ceded and assumed balances from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Run the ceded and assumed balance extract for the reporting period.
Include written and earned premium, paid and outstanding recoveries, and assumed premium income.
Record the extract date on the extract header.
Done when the period extract is produced with its extract date recorded.
verify: Check the extract header for period and extract date values.
Pass when both period and extract date are populated.

steps.title: Load the extract into the enterprise data warehouse reporting layer
sop: Load the extract into the reinsurance reporting tables in the data warehouse.
Run the load validation for null keys, duplicate programs, and out-of-period rows.
Clear every load validation failure before proceeding.
Done when the load completes with no open validation failure.
verify: Review the load validation report for open failures.
Pass when the validation run shows zero open failures.

steps.title: Reconcile ceded balances to the general ledger control accounts
sop: Pull the reinsurance control account balances for the reporting period.
Compare ceded premium and recoverable balances in the dataset to those accounts.
Itemise and clear or explain each difference before publication.
Done when all control account differences are cleared or explained.
verify: Review the reconciliation for residual unexplained differences.
Pass when no unreconciled difference remains against the control accounts.

steps.title: Calculate assumed combined ratio by treaty class
sop: Compute assumed premium income and incurred loss by treaty class for the period.
Add acquisition and expense loads to derive the combined ratio per class.
Check no treaty class carries a null component in the ratio.
Done when combined ratio is calculated for every assumed treaty class.
verify: Filter treaty classes for null ratio components.
Pass when every class has a complete combined ratio.

steps.title: Restate prior period comparatives on the same basis
sop: Restate the prior period figures using the current reporting basis.
Compare restated to originally published prior figures and quantify the change.
Write a footnote explaining every restatement made.
Done when comparatives are restated and footnoted.
verify: Check each restated line has a matching footnote entry.
Pass when no restatement is published without a footnote.

steps.title: Publish the metrics to the BI/reporting platform
sop: Publish ceded and assumed metrics by program and treaty class to the BI/reporting platform.
Stamp the published dataset with reporting period, extract date, and version reference.
Confirm the published totals agree to the reconciled warehouse tables.
Done when the metrics are published and stamped for the period.
verify: Read the published dataset properties for period, extract date, and version.
Pass when all three stamps are populated on the published dataset.

steps.title: Confirm the published figures with the Reinsurance Accountant
sop: Compare the published ceded balances against the reconciled control accounts.
Challenge any figure that moved after the reconciliation was signed.
Record confirmation of the published dataset for the period.
Done when the published dataset is confirmed by the Reinsurance Accountant.
verify: Check the confirmation record names the dataset version and the date.
Pass when confirmation is recorded against the published version.

generic.Defined scope/population: All cedents with an expected bordereaux submission plus unprocessed cessions and suspense cash for the period
generic.In-scope period: The operational reporting period covered by the metrics tile
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Received date, due date, rejection reason, ageing, and tolerance status populated per metric
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Expected cedent submissions counted equal submissions tracked in the metric set
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Metrics workbook and published tile retained with the period and refresh timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every metric breaching its agreed tolerance logged as an exception with an owner and action
generic.Test population: All expected cedent submissions and all defined operational metrics for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any expected submission lacks received and due dates or a metric has no current-period value
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Analyst raises tolerance breaches to the Reinsurance Ops Manager for remedial action
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Current-period values published for each defined metric with breaches raised as exceptions
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance operations dashboard on the BI/reporting platform plus the period metrics workbook

steps.title: Extract bordereaux receipt data from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Run the bordereaux receipt extract for the period listing each cedent submission.
Include due date, received date, and processing status per submission.
Add expected submissions that were never received as open rows.
Done when the receipt extract covers every expected cedent submission.
verify: Compare the extract cedent list to the expected submission schedule.
Pass when received and due dates are populated for every expected submission.

steps.title: Calculate the on-time submission rate in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load the receipt extract into the operational metrics workbook.
Compute days late per submission and the on-time rate for the period.
Split the rate by cedent so persistent late submitters are visible.
Done when the on-time submission rate is calculated for the period.
verify: Recompute the on-time rate from the underlying rows.
Pass when the recomputed rate agrees to the workbook figure.

steps.title: Classify rejected and re-submitted bordereaux by reason
sop: List bordereaux rejected or re-submitted in the period from the administration system.
Classify each rejection as format, missing fields, or failed control totals.
Count rejections by reason and by cedent.
Done when every rejection carries a classified reason.
verify: Filter rejection rows for a blank reason classification.
Pass when no rejection row is left unclassified.

steps.title: Measure ageing of unprocessed cessions and suspense cash
sop: Extract unprocessed cessions and unallocated cash in the reinsurance suspense account.
Age each item into the agreed ageing buckets at the period end date.
Identify the oldest items and the total value sitting beyond tolerance.
Done when ageing is calculated for unprocessed cessions and suspense cash.
verify: Check every item carries an ageing bucket at the period end date.
Pass when no unprocessed item is left without an ageing bucket.

steps.title: Compare each metric against its agreed tolerance
sop: Apply the agreed tolerance to each operational metric for the period.
Mark each metric as within tolerance or breaching.
Raise an exception entry for every breach with the driver identified.
Done when every metric carries a tolerance status.
verify: Filter the metric set for entries without a tolerance status.
Pass when every metric shows a status and each breach has an exception.

steps.title: Publish the operational metrics tile to the reinsurance operations dashboard
sop: Publish the period metric values to the operations dashboard on the BI/reporting platform.
Stamp the tile with the reporting period and refresh timestamp.
Confirm each defined metric shows a current-period value.
Done when the metrics tile is published for the period.
verify: Open the dashboard and read the value and period on each metric.
Pass when current-period values are published for every defined metric.

steps.title: Review breaches and assign remedial action
sop: Review every tolerance breach raised for the period.
Assign a remedial owner and target date for each breach.
Confirm the published metrics reflect the reviewed position.
Done when each breach has an assigned owner and target date.
verify: Filter the exception list for entries without an owner or a target date.
Pass when no breach is left without an owner and a target date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All assumed treaty classes with paid and incurred triangles requiring development factor selection
generic.In-scope period: The factor review cycle covering underwriting years since the last selection review
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss development factor, tail factor, IBNR basis, and rationale populated per treaty class
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Triangle totals agree to the assumed loss extract for the same underwriting years
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Factor selections saved with a versioned model run reference and review date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Factors changed from the prior review logged with a rationale and peer review outcome
generic.Test population: Every selected development and tail factor for the assumed treaty classes in scope
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any changed factor has no written rationale or no peer reviewer sign-off
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Actuary refers unresolved challenge points back into the factor selection paper
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Agreed factor set saved under a versioned run with peer review recorded
generic.Evidence location: Actuarial modeling platform run library plus the factor selection paper

steps.title: Extract the assumed loss data for triangle construction
sop: Extract assumed paid and incurred losses by underwriting year and treaty class.
Include the development period so the data can be arrayed into triangles.
Agree record counts and loss totals with the actuary before hand-off.
Done when the assumed loss extract is delivered with agreed totals.
verify: Compare extract loss totals to the assumed ledger for the same years.
Pass when extract totals agree to the ledger within the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Build paid and incurred triangles in the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Load the assumed loss extract into the actuarial modeling platform.
Build paid and incurred triangles by underwriting year and treaty class.
Check the latest diagonal against the extract for each treaty class.
Done when triangles are built for every in-scope treaty class.
verify: Reconcile each triangle latest diagonal to the source extract.
Pass when every triangle ties to the extract for its treaty class.

steps.title: Select development and tail factors per treaty class
sop: Review link ratios and select development factors for each treaty class.
Select the tail factor and document the curve or method used.
Note where the selection differs from the prior review and why.
Done when factors and tails are selected for every treaty class.
verify: Compare each selection against the prior review selection.
Pass when every changed factor carries a written rationale.

steps.title: Agree the IBNR basis for long-tail assumed classes
sop: Discuss the IBNR method for long-tail assumed classes with the reserving actuary.
Agree the method and any blending between chain ladder and expected loss ratio.
Record the agreed method against each long-tail class.
Done when the IBNR basis is agreed and recorded for long-tail classes.
verify: Check each long-tail class carries a recorded IBNR method.
Pass when no long-tail class is left without an agreed method.

steps.title: Test selections against actual-versus-expected emergence
sop: Compare emerged losses since the last review to the expectation under prior factors.
Apply the new selections and test whether emergence is better explained.
Note any material distortion from large losses or commutations.
Done when actual-versus-expected testing is complete for the selections.
verify: Review the actual-versus-expected output for unexplained distortion.
Pass when every material distortion is identified and noted.

steps.title: Document the selections in the factor selection paper
sop: Write the selection paper in Microsoft Excel covering method, data, and selections.
Include the rationale for each changed factor and the actual-versus-expected result.
Attach the triangle exhibits supporting the selections.
Done when the factor selection paper is drafted with rationale and exhibits.
verify: Check each changed factor in the paper has a rationale entry.
Pass when no changed factor is documented without a rationale.

steps.title: Obtain peer review and log challenge points
sop: Send the selection paper for peer review by the reserving actuary.
Log the reviewer name, review date, and every challenge point raised.
Address each challenge point and record the resolution.
Done when peer review is complete with all challenge points resolved.
verify: Review the challenge log for unresolved points.
Pass when peer reviewer sign-off is recorded with no open challenge.

steps.title: Save the agreed factor set under a versioned run reference
sop: Save the agreed factors into the actuarial modeling platform run library.
Assign a version reference and record the effective review cycle.
Lock the run so downstream reserving uses the agreed version.
Done when the factor set is saved with a versioned run reference.
verify: Open the run library entry and read the version reference and date.
Pass when the saved factors carry a versioned run reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: All reinsurance assumptions feeding the reserve review across ceded and assumed programs
generic.In-scope period: The reserve review cycle for which the assumptions are being documented
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Retentions, limits, reinstatements, aggregate deductibles, and commission structures recorded per treaty
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Treaties documented equal the treaties in force for the reserve review period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved assumptions paper filed with version number and approval date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Known data limitations recorded with their effect on the reserve estimate and the mitigation
generic.Test population: Every documented assumption in the approved assumptions paper
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any assumption lacks a named owner and a stated basis or the paper lacks an approval date
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Actuary escalates unconfirmed treaty terms to the Reinsurance Manager before approval
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assumptions paper approved and filed with a version reference in the reserving library
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository reserving documentation library for the review cycle

steps.title: List the treaty terms applied in the reserve review
sop: Extract the treaty terms used in the reserve review from the actuarial modeling platform.
Record retentions, limits, reinstatements, aggregate deductibles, and commission structures.
Cover both ceded and assumed programs in force for the review period.
Done when the treaty terms schedule is drafted for the review.
verify: Compare the schedule treaty count to the in-force treaty list for the period.
Pass when every in-force treaty appears in the schedule.

steps.title: State the ceded recoverable and counterparty-default assumptions
sop: Document the recoverable recognition assumption used in the reserve review.
Document the counterparty-default assumption and the basis for the rate applied.
Reference the source analysis for each assumption.
Done when recoverable and default assumptions are documented with their basis.
verify: Check each assumption entry carries a stated basis and a source reference.
Pass when no assumption is recorded without a basis.

steps.title: Record data limitations affecting the reserve estimate
sop: List known data limitations in the ceded and assumed data used.
Describe the effect each limitation has on the reserve estimate.
State the mitigation or judgement applied to compensate.
Done when every known limitation is recorded with its effect.
verify: Read each limitation entry for a stated effect and mitigation.
Pass when no limitation is recorded without an effect and a mitigation.

steps.title: Assign a named owner to each documented assumption
sop: Assign a named owner to each assumption in the paper.
Confirm the owner accepts the assumption as stated.
Record the owner name against every assumption row.
Done when every assumption carries a named owner.
verify: Filter the assumptions table for rows without an owner.
Pass when no assumption is left without a named owner.

steps.title: Confirm documented terms match the placed program
sop: Compare the documented treaty terms against the program as currently placed.
Challenge any retention, limit, or commission that differs from the placement.
Confirm the terms schedule matches the placed program.
Done when the Reinsurance Manager confirms the documented terms.
verify: Check the confirmation entry names the reviewer and the schedule version.
Pass when confirmation is recorded against the final terms schedule.

steps.title: Obtain approval of the assumptions paper
sop: Review the complete assumptions paper including limitations and owners.
Approve or return the paper with points to address.
Record the approval decision and the approval date.
Done when the assumptions paper is approved with a recorded date.
verify: Read the approval record for approver name and approval date.
Pass when the approval is recorded against the final paper version.

steps.title: File the approved paper in the reserving documentation library
sop: Upload the approved assumptions paper to the document management repository.
Apply the version number and the review cycle reference to the record.
Supersede the prior cycle version in the library.
Done when the approved paper is filed with a version reference.
verify: Open the library record and read version number and approval date.
Pass when both are present on the filed version.

generic.Defined scope/population: Signed-off ceded and assumed IBNR indications for all programs in the reporting period
generic.In-scope period: The financial reporting period into which the actuarial indications are booked
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reserve indication amounts, actuarial output version, and journal narrative populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported ceded and assumed reserve balances agree line by line to the actuarial output
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Journal, load file, and reconciliation retained with the actuarial output version reference
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Movements above the reporting materiality threshold logged with commentary and disposition
generic.Test population: All reserve lines loaded into the reinsurance reporting layer for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the journal narrative omits the actuarial version or any reserve difference is unexplained
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Accountant refers differences against the indication to the Reinsurance Actuary
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reporting reflects the signed-off indications with a full reconciliation and commentary
generic.Evidence location: Period reserve support folder holding the load file, journal, and reconciliation

steps.title: Obtain the signed-off ceded and assumed IBNR indications
sop: Export the signed-off ceded and assumed IBNR indications for the period.
Record the actuarial output version reference on the export.
Confirm the export is the version approved for booking.
Done when the signed-off indications are exported with a version reference.
verify: Compare the export version against the reserve sign-off record.
Pass when the exported version matches the signed-off version.

steps.title: Load the indications into the reinsurance reporting layer
sop: Load the indication file into the reinsurance administration system reporting layer.
Map each indication line to its program and reporting segment.
Clear any unmapped line before completing the load.
Done when all indication lines are loaded and mapped.
verify: Compare loaded line count to the indication export line count.
Pass when counts agree with no unmapped line remaining.

steps.title: Post the ceded reserve credit movement journal in the general ledger
sop: Calculate the ceded reserve credit movement for the period.
Post the journal in the ERP general ledger to the reinsurance reserve accounts.
Reference the actuarial output version in the journal narrative.
Done when the reserve movement journal is posted with a version reference.
verify: Read the posted journal narrative for the actuarial version reference.
Pass when the narrative names the signed-off actuarial output version.

steps.title: Confirm reserve credit does not exceed the placed program recoverable
sop: Compare the ceded reserve credit booked against the recoverable supported by the placed program.
Identify any program where the credit exceeds available limit.
Restrict the credit and document the restriction where an excess is found.
Done when reserve credit is confirmed within the placed program limits.
verify: Test the booked credit against program limit for each program.
Pass when no program shows credit above the supported recoverable.

steps.title: Reconcile reported reserves to the actuarial output line by line
sop: Build the reconciliation between reported ceded and assumed reserves and the actuarial output.
Itemise every difference with its cause.
Clear or explain each difference in the reconciliation.
Done when the line by line reconciliation is complete.
verify: Review the reconciliation for unexplained residual differences.
Pass when no unexplained difference remains against the indication.

steps.title: Write the reserve movement commentary in Microsoft Excel
sop: List movements above the reporting materiality threshold for the period.
Write commentary explaining the driver of each material movement.
Attach the commentary to the period reserve support pack.
Done when every material movement carries a written commentary.
verify: Filter material movements for entries without commentary.
Pass when no material movement is left unexplained.

steps.title: Confirm the booked position agrees with the actuarial indication
sop: Review the reconciliation and the posted reserve position for the period.
Challenge any booked figure that departs from the signed-off indication.
Record confirmation that reporting reflects the indications.
Done when the actuary confirms the booked reserve position.
verify: Check the confirmation names the output version and the period.
Pass when the confirmation is recorded against the booked position.

generic.Defined scope/population: Assumed and ceded reinsurance topics on the annual loss reserve workshop agenda
generic.In-scope period: The annual reserve review cycle covered by the workshop
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attendance, challenge points, program changes, and arising actions recorded for the session
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Actions in the minutes equal actions carried into the reinsurance action list
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Workshop minutes and action list filed to the reserving workspace with the session date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unresolved reinsurance challenge points logged as actions with owners and due dates
generic.Test population: The workshop attendance record and every reinsurance action arising
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the reinsurance representative is missing from attendance or an action lacks owner or due date
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Manager assigns unresolved points to the Reinsurance Actuary with a due date
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Participation recorded with minutes and reinsurance actions filed to the reserving workspace
generic.Evidence location: Reserving workspace on Microsoft 365 / SharePoint holding minutes and the action list

steps.title: Review the pre-read reserving pack
sop: Download the pre-read reserving pack from Microsoft 365 / SharePoint.
Read the ceded and assumed sections against the current program position.
Note where the pack view conflicts with known program facts.
Done when the pre-read pack has been reviewed and notes taken.
verify: Check the notes cover both ceded and assumed sections of the pack.
Pass when review notes exist for both sections.

steps.title: Prepare reinsurance challenge points for the workshop
sop: Convert the review notes into specific challenge points for the session.
Reference the treaty, class, or event behind each challenge point.
Share the challenge list with the Reinsurance Actuary before the session.
Done when the challenge list is prepared and shared.
verify: Check each challenge point names a treaty, class, or event.
Pass when no challenge point is stated without a reference.

steps.title: Present ceded and assumed program changes affecting segmentation
sop: Present program changes since the last review that affect reserve segmentation.
Explain how retention, limit, or structure changes alter the ceded pattern.
Confirm the reserving team has captured each change.
Done when program changes have been presented and captured.
verify: Compare the changes presented against the placement record for the year.
Pass when every material program change was presented.

steps.title: Raise commutations, run-off, and restructures affecting recoverables
sop: List treaty commutations, run-off transfers, and restructures in the period.
Explain how each changes the recoverable profile in the reserve view.
Confirm the reserving model treatment for each item.
Done when every commutation, run-off, and restructure is raised.
verify: Compare items raised against the treaty status register.
Pass when no commutation or run-off in the register is omitted.

steps.title: Record attendance for the workshop session
sop: Record attendees from the Microsoft Teams session or the sign-in sheet.
Confirm the reinsurance representative is listed on the attendance record.
File the attendance record with the session date.
Done when attendance is recorded for the session.
verify: Read the attendance record for the reinsurance representative entry.
Pass when the reinsurance representative is listed for the session.

steps.title: Capture reinsurance actions with owners and due dates
sop: List each reinsurance action arising from the workshop.
Assign a named owner and a due date to each action.
Confirm the owner accepts the action before the session closes.
Done when every reinsurance action has an owner and a due date.
verify: Filter the action list for entries without an owner or a due date.
Pass when no reinsurance action lacks an owner and a due date.

steps.title: File the minutes and reinsurance action list to the reserving workspace
sop: Upload the workshop minutes to the reserving workspace on Microsoft 365 / SharePoint.
Attach the reinsurance action list to the same workspace item.
Circulate the filed location to attendees via Microsoft Teams / Email.
Done when minutes and the action list are filed and circulated.
verify: Open the workspace item and confirm minutes and action list are present.
Pass when both artefacts are filed for the workshop.

generic.Defined scope/population: All ceded paid losses, outstanding case recoverables, and ceded premium by treaty and underwriting year
generic.In-scope period: The reserving data period agreed with actuarial for the review cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty reference, underwriting year, line of business, and amounts populated on every record
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Record counts and monetary control totals agreed with the receiving actuary
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Delivered package retained with delivery date, file version, and data dictionary
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Excluded, restated, and manually adjusted records listed with the reason for each
generic.Test population: Every cession record in the delivered reserving package
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any cession record has no valid treaty reference or control totals do not match
generic.Exception handling path: Ceded Reinsurance Analyst clears unmapped cessions before delivery and flags residual gaps
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reserving-ready package delivered with matching control totals and a data dictionary
generic.Evidence location: Actuarial data location plus the ceded reserving package delivery log

steps.title: Extract ceded losses and recoverables from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Run the ceded extract for paid losses, outstanding case recoverables, and ceded premium.
Break the data by treaty, underwriting year, and line of business.
Record the extract date and the as-at position on the file header.
Done when the ceded extract is produced for the reserving period.
verify: Check the extract header carries extract date and as-at position.
Pass when both are populated on the extract.

steps.title: Map every cession to its treaty reference
sop: Join each cession record to the treaty master by treaty reference.
List cessions that fail to map and trace them to the source cession record.
Correct or assign the treaty reference for every unmapped cession.
Done when every cession record carries a valid treaty reference.
verify: Filter the dataset for records without a valid treaty reference.
Pass when no cession record is left unmapped.

steps.title: Stage the package in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Load the mapped extract into the reserving staging tables in the data warehouse.
Run the agreed structural checks for nulls, duplicates, and out-of-period rows.
Clear every check failure before the package is finalised.
Done when the staged package passes the structural checks.
verify: Review the staging check report for open failures.
Pass when the staged package shows zero open check failures.

steps.title: Agree record counts and control totals with the receiving actuary
sop: Compare the package record count and monetary totals against the source extract.
Confirm the totals against the ceded ledger for the same period.
Record the agreed counts and totals in the delivery note.
Done when counts and control totals are agreed and recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded control totals to the package totals.
Pass when the package totals match the agreed control totals.

steps.title: Produce the data dictionary and exclusions note in Microsoft Excel
sop: Write the data dictionary describing every field and its permitted values.
List excluded, restated, and manually adjusted records with the reason for each.
Attach both to the package as supporting documentation.
Done when the dictionary and exclusions note are attached.
verify: Check every field in the package appears in the dictionary.
Pass when no package field is undocumented.

steps.title: Deliver the package to the actuarial data location
sop: Copy the finalised package to the agreed actuarial data location.
Apply the file version reference and delivery date to the file name.
Notify the receiving actuary that the package is available.
Done when the package is delivered and the actuary is notified.
verify: Open the delivered file and read version reference and delivery date.
Pass when both are present on the delivered package.

steps.title: Log the delivery and confirm actuarial acceptance
sop: Record the delivery date and file version in the reserving delivery log.
Run acceptance checks on the received package against the agreed totals.
Confirm acceptance or return the package with defects listed.
Done when the package is accepted or returned with defects.
verify: Read the delivery log entry for acceptance status and date.
Pass when the package is recorded as accepted with matching control totals.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded and assumed premium, loss, and exposure records by treaty and underwriting year for the quarter
generic.In-scope period: The reporting quarter, submitted by the quarterly actuarial data deadline
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty key, underwriting year, premium, loss, and exposure fields populated and typed correctly
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Dataset totals reconcile to the quarter-end reinsurance ledger balances
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Submitted dataset retained with submission reference, validation run, and reconciliation attached
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Validation failures logged with the correction applied and the re-run outcome
generic.Test population: The full quarterly dataset submitted to actuarial
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any validation rule remains failed or the submission misses the quarterly deadline
generic.Exception handling path: Reinsurance Analyst corrects failing records and re-runs validation before resubmission
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Quarterly dataset submitted with a passing validation run and actuarial acceptance recorded
generic.Evidence location: Enterprise data warehouse quarterly submission area plus the submission log

steps.title: Produce the quarterly ceded and assumed dataset
sop: Run the quarterly premium, loss, and exposure extract from the reinsurance administration system.
Break the data by treaty and underwriting year for ceded and assumed.
Stage the dataset in the enterprise data warehouse quarterly area.
Done when the quarterly dataset is produced and staged.
verify: Compare the staged treaty list against the quarter in-force register.
Pass when every in-force treaty appears in the dataset.

steps.title: Run the agreed validation rules on the dataset
sop: Execute the agreed validation rules for null keys and negative premium.
Execute the duplicate cession and out-of-period transaction rules.
Export the validation result with the failure detail.
Done when the validation run completes and results are exported.
verify: Read the validation export for the count of failures by rule.
Pass when the validation run produced a result for every agreed rule.

steps.title: Clear every validation failure
sop: Trace each failing record back to its source cession or transaction.
Correct the record in the reinsurance administration system where the data is wrong.
Re-run the validation until no failure remains.
Done when the dataset passes validation with zero failures.
verify: Review the final validation run for open failures.
Pass when no open validation failure remains on the dataset.

steps.title: Reconcile dataset totals to the quarter-end ledger
sop: Pull the quarter-end reinsurance ledger balances for ceded and assumed.
Compare dataset premium and loss totals to those balances in Microsoft Excel.
Explain or clear each difference and attach the reconciliation.
Done when the reconciliation is complete and attached to the dataset.
verify: Review the reconciliation for unexplained residual differences.
Pass when no unexplained difference remains against the ledger.

steps.title: Submit the dataset by the quarterly actuarial deadline
sop: Publish the validated dataset to the agreed actuarial submission location.
Record the submission reference, version, and submission timestamp.
Notify the receiving actuary that the quarterly dataset is available.
Done when the dataset is submitted and the reference recorded.
verify: Compare the submission timestamp to the quarterly deadline.
Pass when the submission occurred on or before the deadline.

steps.title: Confirm actuarial acceptance of the quarterly dataset
sop: Run the receiving checks on the submitted dataset against the reconciliation.
Raise any defect found back to the analyst with the failing records named.
Record acceptance of the dataset for the quarter.
Done when acceptance or defect return is recorded for the quarter.
verify: Read the submission log for the acceptance entry and its date.
Pass when acceptance is recorded against the submitted version.

steps.title: Close the quarterly data task in the submission log
sop: Update the submission log with the acceptance outcome for the quarter.
Attach the validation run and the ledger reconciliation to the log entry.
Close the quarterly data task once acceptance is recorded.
Done when the quarterly data task is closed with evidence attached.
verify: Open the log entry and confirm validation run and reconciliation are attached.
Pass when both artefacts are attached to the closed entry.
